reference_protocol.name: One target sprite -> one tightly cropped original reference
steps: Locate target component inside corresponding reference screenshot, not inside the full UI sheet.
Crop closely around only that component; exclude adjacent buttons, entire page structures, text unrelated to the asset, and irrelevant scene background. Inspect crop before generation.
If original crop is very small, upscale with sharp-edge-preserving resampling for viewing only; record original pixel bounding box and avoid inventing unseen detail.
Use only this single cropped icon region as the generative visual reference. Never feed whole 16:9 screenshot, V3/V4 97-icon atlas, or a status dashboard to image generation.
Request exactly one isolated sprite, transparent background, original proportions/color/line weight; no decorations or new backing card, no text burned into icon when separate text layer exists.
Compare output to crop and actual in-game display size, reject incorrect shape/extra elements, log failure; only passed candidates may be promoted to production.
reference_protocol.output: individual transparent RGBA PNG + exact crop reference + comparison + checksum + honest QA metadata
reference_protocol.binding_rule: Reference crop saved locally is NOT proof image generator consumed it. For each new target, explicitly verify current single image is actually attached/used for image editing; no previous generated image as reference.
preflight: Fetch live queue and check whether target has a recovered candidate before generating.
One target ID and exactly one tight source crop, no review sheet or previous asset images.
State target silhouette, main palette, distinctive parts and forbidden previous-target identities.
postflight: Inspect generated object identity before aesthetics and alpha.
If generated object matches another queued target, archive under actual identity, mark current target not done, and never discard useful valid art.
After two misroutes, stop generation, leave current target for retry and advance to next never-attempted item without counting completion.
User design acceptance is separate from technical QA and production promotion.

production_batch_size_goal.rule: Latest user explicitly requests one at a time; inspect each before the next. No multi-control generation, quality above speed.

deferred_retry_policy: Skip prior failed icon image-generation attempts until all never-attempted HUD/other remaining queue items receive first candidates; preserve their failed status and revisit at end. Do not count them as approved.

generation_target_integrity_protocol.rule: Only ONE clearly named current_target per generation, separate from previous tasks. Before invocation validate target id, attached single tight reference crop, literal subject, forbid wrong prior subject. After tool call verify the result depicts CURRENT target, independently of visual quality.
generation_target_integrity_protocol.target_switch_failsafe: If the generator returns the previous icon/topic, do not immediately retry using same stale context; mark as reference-binding mismatch, preserve generated image under the correct asset if useful, and advance or change controlled target method. Never count as current asset.
generation_target_integrity_protocol.qa_policy: Separate functional identity vs aesthetic quality vs alpha/game size; user can accept quality of an asset even when it was generated under the wrong task.
